clips.title: Atlantis final separation from the ISS
clips.speaker: Chris Ferguson, Atlantis, and Ron Garan, Expedition 28
clips.transcript: Physical separation. Ron Garan, ringing the ship’s bell in Harmony: Atlantis, departing the International Space Station for the last time. Ferguson: Farewell, ISS. Make us proud.

clips.title: STS-135 farewell before undocking
clips.speaker: STS-135 crew and Expedition 28
clips.transcript: Farewell ceremony aboard the station on the day before Atlantis undocked. The Houston Audio Control Room release is the ceremony itself.
